rationale: B wins because it knows when a story is real and when it is a hole with a headline on it. Its benchmark angle, "Can a 1.8B model really match one 4x its size? Hugging Face's own numbers say maybe," keeps the self-reported evidence in frame, while A blows a key customer angle into "The Factory That Runs AI Without a Cloud Connection," a claim the update never gives you. A has better scaffolding; B is the set I would let a founder use before a reporter starts pulling threads.
gaps_in_A: "The Factory That Runs AI Without a Cloud Connection" invents the factory setting, the no-cloud deployment, and the operational use case. The update only says a named Fortune 100 manufacturer is an early enterprise customer and that the model can run offline.

"Offline AI That Runs on a Laptop Is Now Good Enough for a Fortune 100 Factory" smuggles an unreproduced benchmark and an unspecified customer citation into a capability conclusion. That is how you buy yourself a correction.

"no per-query costs, no data leaving the network, and no contract to renegotiate when pricing changes" overstates what Apache 2.0 and offline execution prove. Deployment architecture and procurement terms are not in the facts.
"The story is epistemological, not strategic" is angle-generator perfume. It may be true, but it helps the writer feel clever more than it helps the founder pitch.
gaps_in_B: "privacy, cost, and latency case for local AI" is plausible, but it is not supplied as a fact. Treat it as a reporting hypothesis and prove it with tests or users.
"regulated, conservative buyer" decorates the Fortune 100 manufacturer beyond the update. A manufacturer may be both, but the fact block does not give you that.
"the weights are open" needs confirmation. The update says the model is open-sourced under Apache 2.0; an open-weights reporter will still ask exactly what is licensed.
B leaves a useful enterprise IT/licensing angle underdeveloped. The Apache 2.0 point appears in proof questions, but it could have been a distinct buyer-side story if handled carefully.
